title: Regain root through a program named sudo
threat_model: An attacker runs the same escalation through a program with a name that an allow list for escalation helpers ignores.
known_gap: privilege_escalation skips requests whose comm is on its expected-escalator list, and the comm is the name of the file that was run, so a symlink to python3 named sudo is suppressed.
notes: As S24, but python3 is run through a symlink named sudo in the work directory (as in case c of the live test). The real sudo is not run.
